text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Elias Hrawi said: "Trespassing the boundaries of freedom leads to chaos and ultimately to dictatorship."
- Israeli bombs kill a civilian, wound two in south Lebanon.
- Parliamentary committee for foreign affairs wants Arabs to break off relations with Turkey.
- More evacuees arrive in Beirut from Sierra Leone.
- Lebanon accuses Israel of breaching terms of a 1996 ceasefire understanding.
- Newspapers might call a strike in a show of solidarity with arrested labour leader.
- Bank of Lebanon Governor Riad Salameh: Current interest rates are acceptable.
